title: Inventory Mail Room Technician (Fort Worth, TX)
description:
Paladin Consulting is currently hiring a Inventory Mail Room Technician to join our team working onsite at our client's office located in Fort Worth, TX.

We work with companies that offer environments for our employees to contribute, learn, and advance their career. We treat you like you are part of the family.

Title: Inventory Mail Room Technician
Work Location: Fort Worth, TX
Duration: 3 month contract
Education/Experience Required: High School Diploma or GED
Shift: 7:00am-3:30pm, Sunday-Thursday or Tuesday-Saturday.

Job Description :
  • Under the direct supervision of the Supply Chain Lead, Supervisor, Manager or Director, the employee performs a variety of Supply Chain duties in all four of the following Supply Chain departments: Receiving, Inventory & Distribution, Mail Room, and Courier Services.
  • Team members will be assigned and trained to these four Supply Chain departments and their related duties according to the business requirements of CCHCS.
  • The employee will follow the specific processes pertinent to each Supply Chain department while maintaining quality and productivity standards.
Job Responsibilities:
  • 10% Accurately sorts and separates incoming and outgoing mail.
    • Meters outgoing mail and packages, processes and prepares presorted mail.
    • Follows established pick-up and delivery routes for mail and packages.
    • Verifies required signatures and maintains required supporting documentation.
  • 10% Delivers to and maintains clinical supply carts, using standard PAR and Kanban (two-bin) replenishment system standard operating procedures.
    • Accurately scans empty Kanban bins to create pick tickets for supply replenishment.
    • Accurately picks stock to physically replenish standard PAR and Kanban bins.
    • Cleans Kanban supply bins according to standard operating procedure.
  • 10% Delivery of all items based on established routes to various Care System facilities.
    • Performs all computer and handheld functions necessary to process and track various aspects of shipments.
  • 10% Operates delivery vehicle in a safe and responsible manner.
    • Reports damages, maintenance and operating problems with the vehicle and coordinates routine and periodic maintenance services with Supervisor/Supply Chain leader and the Care System Fleet Manager.
    • Refuels and secures vehicle at the end of each workday and follows vehicle safety check procedures.
    • Maintains a daily log of stops made, service provided, and mileage driven.
    • Verifies Toll Tag expenses as requested.
    • Responsible for pick-up of internal returned goods.
  • 10% Prioritizes deliveries ex. overnight, temperature control and expedited customer requests.
    • Stages received LTL (Less Than Load) items for same day delivery as well as restocking.
    • Makes arrangements for delivery and pick up by various carriers.
    • Accurately puts away received inventoried product in the correct Storeroom bin locations.
  • 10% Receives supplies and/or equipment entering the hospital using One Piece Flow process and Lawson and MSCM supply chain systems.
    • Performs functions necessary to dock log, process, deliver, pick up and track various shipments utilizing the handheld and the computer.
    • Identifies discrepancies or damaged shipments and reports to Procurement Department.
    • Assists in trouble shooting problem packages. -5% Correctly utilizes the following Supply Chain programs and functions: Mobile Supply Chain Management (MSCM), Kanban bin scanning, stock issue, stock transfer, and return stock processing using hand held device or computer, as appropriate.
  • 5% Ensures sufficient postage funds are available to operate mail equipment.
    • Facilitates maintenance and repair of equipment.
    • Performs backup processing of mail for other system companies with independent handling staff, i.e. Physicians Network and Health Plan, as required.
  • 5% Pick supplies to fill requisition orders and stat calls.
    • Includes ensuring the documentation of the issuance of these items in Lawson.
    • Ensures patient chargeable supplies are marked with appropriate label according to standard operating procedure.
Skills & Qualifications :
  • Required Education: High School Diploma or GED.
  • Demonstrated ability to read and write.
  • Ability to perform basic math and organizational skills.
  • Able to establish and maintain professional working relationships and a professional image with customers, supervisors, and peers.
  • Ability to complete tasks without direct supervision, prioritize projects, and meet project deadlines.
  • Performs daily aisle management verifying that stock is rotated, expired items removed, overstock addressed, product straightened, and empty boxes and cartons removed.
  • Accurately puts away received inventoried product in the correct Inventory & Distribution bin locations.
  • Processes unidentified and return to sender mail, and forwards patient mail for prompt delivery.

For more information or to view other opportunities, visit us at www.paladininc.com.

Paladin Consulting is an EEOC employer.

title: Customer Service Representative (Highland Hills, OH)
description:

We work with companies that offer environments for our employees to contribute, learn, and advance their career. We treat you like you are part of the family.

Job Title: Customer Service Representative
Work Location: Highland Hills, OH
Duration: Long-term contract with option to extend or hire
Hours: Monday-Friday 9am-5:30pm

Job Description & Responsibilities :
  • This position provides back office support to client base.
  • This includes, but is not limited to, payroll and billing processes.
  • Verifies all data has been entered in order to process client payroll and billing timely and accurately
  • Timely and professional response to customers enquiries.
  • New customer set up and data entry.
  • Accurate maintenance of all customer databases. This includes client payroll data and billing data.
  • Updates customer folders with changes to reflect current week's payroll and billing instructions.
  • Processes credits/rebills.
  • Assists clients in developing effective processes for reporting their payroll and billing information accurately and timely as needed.
  • Provides repeat training or answer lower level technical questions regarding software usage of payroll and billing platform.
  • Timely transmission of accounting and payments reports such as wires, ACH, and A/R credits/debits.
  • Promptly notify management of problem areas.
Skills & Qualifications :
  • Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or related field preferred
  • Previous experience in payroll processing
  • Comparable Work Experience.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills.
  • Excellent oral and written communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to use multiple types of software including MS Office and proficiency in basic office equipment.
  • Understanding of basic accounting principles including payroll, payroll taxes, A/P, A/R, and cash posting.
  • Ability to understand relationships of data in multiple databases and good with numbers, particularly reconciling differences.
  • Must be detail oriented, customer focused, proactive and able to work under pressure.
  • Act with uncompromising integrity.
  • Provide outstanding service and build trusted relationships.
  • Drive innovation in our products and services and continually improve our processes.
  • Work in partnership and support each other.
  • Be personally accountable and deliver on commitments.
  • Treat each other with respect and dignity.

title: Electrician (Pleasant Prairie, WI)
description:
Paladin Consulting is currently hiring an Electrician to join our team working onsite at our client's office located in Pleasant Prairie, WI.

We work with companies that offer environments for our employees to contribute, learn, and advance their career. We treat you like you are part of the family.

Job Title: Electrician
Work Location: Pleasant Prairie, WI
Duration: 5 month contract with option to extend or hire
Education/Experience Required: High School Diploma, GED, or trade school diploma with 3-4 years of job-related experience. Completion of a formal apprenticeship program preferred.

Job Description & Responsibilities :
  • As a Electrician, you will inspect, repair, and maintain mechanical and electrical equipment in assigned facilities.
  • Perform Preventative Maintenance, repairs and installation of electrical equipment
  • This job is part of the Engineering and Technical Services job function. They are responsible for providing support, preventive maintenance, and repairs on equipment and systems.
  • Oversee electrical and lighting systems' general operation, repair, and maintenance. Perform new installations of equipment.
  • Check, repair, and replace functional components of electrical and lighting systems. This includes valves, motors, controls, switches, gauges, wiring, fans, pumps, compressors, condensers, cores, and pipes.
  • Assure that equipment is being maintained and operating in a safe manner.
  • Review historical maintenance records to create proactive inspection, testing, and preventive maintenance schedules.
  • Provide efficient and reliable service to customers.
  • Apply general knowledge of standard principles and techniques/procedures to accomplish assigned tasks and solve routine problems.
  • Have a broad knowledge of own job discipline and some knowledge of several job disciplines within the function.
  • Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with values. May convince to reach an agreement.
  • Impact the quality of own work and the work of others on the team.
  • Work primarily within standardized procedures and practices to achieve objectives and meet deadlines.
  • Explain complex information to others in straightforward situations.

Skills & Qualifications :
  • 5 years experience
  • High School Diploma, GED, or trade school diploma with 3-4 years of job-related experience. Completion of a formal apprenticeship program preferred.
  • Master Electrician license required as dictated by local electrical codes. Valid Driver's license required.
  • Meet the physical requirements of this role including stooping, standing, walking, climbing stairs/ladders, and the ability to lift/carry heavy loads of 50 lbs. or more.
  • In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
  • Understanding of existing procedures and standards to solve slightly complex problems.
  • Ability to analyze possible solutions using technical experience to apply appropriate judgment and precedents.
  • Strong organizational skills with an inquisitive mindset.
  • Advanced math skills: add, subtract, multiply, divide. Ability to calculate intermediate figures such as percentages discounts and commissions.
Licenses/Certifications:
  • OSHA 10 Construction (Preferred but not necessary)
  • Electrical License Not necessary
Must Have Skills:
  • Commercial / Industrial experience
Nice to have skills:
  • Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment
Soft Skills:
  • Client facing role
  • Good customer skills
  • Highly professional attitude
